name: node_op
description: Manage a device, group/scene, or folder node: enable, disable, delete, rename, or move it, or create a new group/scene or folder. add_group/add_folder's result includes the new node's real id -- use that as new_parent_id for a following move, never the name you gave it. delete is destructive -- only after the customer has explicitly agreed, never speculatively. delete does not work for Z-Wave/Zigbee/Matter devices -- the call is rejected with the real protocol named; use pair_device's exclude action instead to remove it. delete also does not work for a plugin-created device -- the call is rejected; confirm with the customer that they want to uninstall the owning plugin, then use delete_plugin instead. One node per call -- call it once per node.

node_id.description: The node's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed. Not used for add_group/add_folder.

new_name.description: New display name. Required for rename, add_group, add_folder.

new_parent_id.description: The new parent folder or group/scene's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed. For move: omit (or pass an empty string) to move the node to the top level/root instead of into another folder or group/scene -- never invent a placeholder id like 'none' or 'root' for this, there isn't one.
